Junior-Intermediate Frontend Developer
Humankind (on behalf of aviation SaaS client)
Auckland CBD, Auckland
Full time

- Build aviation SaaS used globally 
- Grow your front-end and UX skills fast 
- Use your eye for detail every day  
- Improve product screens and user flows. 
- Build front-end features using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. 
- Support UI, branding and white-labelling updates. 
- Work with product and engineering on improvements. 
- Fix layout, spacing, responsiveness and interaction issues. 
- Spot small details that make the product easier to use. 
- Learn APIs, Python/Django and the wider platform.  

What we are looking for:
- 1–3 years’ front-end or web app experience; strong graduates considered. 
- Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. 
- Genuine interest in front-end, UI/UX and product quality. 
- Strong attention to detail and pride in clean, consistent work. 
- Curiosity, coachability, strong problem-solving and clear written and verbal communication. 
- Full NZ work rights, Auckland-based and able to onboard onsite. 
- Portfolio, GitHub, app, game, bootcamp, uni or personal projects. 

Preferred but not required:
- React, Angular, Vue or another modern front-end framework. 
- Experience improving UI, user flows, layout or responsiveness. 
- Evidence you notice the details that make products easier to use. 
- Exposure to SaaS, web applications or product environments.  
- Python or Django exposure. 
- API integration or backend concepts. 
- UX/UI design, prototyping, wireframing or product thinking. 
- Accessibility or responsive design exposure. 
- Aviation or regulated systems experience.    

What they offer:
- Build real product features in a global aviation SaaS platform. 
- Learn quickly in a supportive, hands-on engineering team. 
- Work across front-end, UX, product and backend concepts. 
- See your work improve how customers use the platform every day. 
- Join a growing international start-up where you can have a real voice early on.
